description: This file defines keyboard shortcut configurations and utility functions for the Notesnook project, including hotkeys and tiptap editor keybindings, normalization, formatting, and grouping functions.

classes.name: Hotkeys
classes.description: Interface representing a hotkey configuration with keys, description, category, and type.

classes.name: TipTapKey
classes.description: Interface representing a TipTap editor keybinding with keys, description, category, and type.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Type representing categories of keybindings, derived from CATEGORIES array.

methods.name: getKeybinding
methods.description: Retrieves the keybinding(s) for a given shortcut, formatted for Mac if specified.

methods.name: normalizeKeys
methods.description: Normalizes key strings based on whether the context is web or desktop.

methods.name: macify
methods.description: Converts key strings to Mac-specific notation.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats a key string into a human-readable form, considering Mac or other OS.

methods.name: getGroupedKeybindings
methods.description: Groups all keybindings by category, formatted for desktop and Mac as specified.
